definitions.gloss: garden tree, yard tree, ornamental tree
definitions.explanation: A tree planted in a garden or yard, typically for decorative purposes. Includes both ornamental and fruit-bearing trees grown in residential gardens.

examples.japanese: {庭木|にわき}の{手入|てい}れをする。
{庭木|にわき}の{枝|えだ}を{剪定|せんてい}した。
examples.english: I pruned the branches of the garden trees.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{庭木|にわき}が{倒|たお}れてしまったので、{業者|ぎょうしゃ}に{撤去|てっきょ}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: A garden tree was knocked over by the typhoon, so I asked a contractor to remove it.

notes:
USAGE:
A common everyday word for trees in residential gardens. Japanese gardens often feature carefully maintained {庭木|にわき}, and tree maintenance (especially {剪定|せんてい}, pruning) is an important part of homeownership.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {庭木|にわき}の{手入|てい}れ: tending garden trees
- {庭木|にわき}を{植|う}える: to plant a garden tree
- {庭木|にわき}を{剪定|せんてい}する: to prune garden trees
- {庭木|にわき}が{茂|しげ}る: garden trees grow thick
